articles.title: Windows 0-day dropped by disgruntled researcher hands hackers System rights
articles.content: "SignDrop" exploit lets local users gain all-powerful System rights.
articles.titleZh: 不满的研究人员泄露Windows 0-day漏洞，黑客获得系统权限
articles.contentZh: “SignDrop”漏洞利用可让本地用户获得全能的系统权限。

articles.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
articles.content: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
articles.titleZh: Grok Build 编码代理泄露大量机密信息，其中一些属于 SpaceXSI
articles.contentZh: 研究人员发现，有35,000个Grok Build应用程序对任何寻找它们的人完全开放。

articles.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
articles.content: "*sshole" poses a serious threat to Internet security.
articles.titleZh: 黑客利用SSH入侵Linux设备的漏洞正被积极利用
articles.contentZh: “*sshole”对互联网安全构成严重威胁。

articles.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
articles.content: Company said a "multifront cyberattack" included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.
articles.titleZh: Chainalysis称，黑客窃取了其所有客户的凭证和代币
articles.contentZh: 该公司表示，这是一次“多方位的网络攻击”，涉及人工智能代理和路径上的数据窃取。

articles.title: Apple’s new study looks to improve the effectiveness of AI health tools
articles.content: Apple announced a new study today with the goal of better understanding how people interact with conversational AI health tools and how useful their responses actually are. The company is conducting the Apple Health AI Usage Study in collaboration with OpenEvidence, a clinical AI platform used by healthcare professionals that generates answers based on medical […]
articles.titleZh: 苹果公司的新研究旨在提高人工智能健康工具的有效性
articles.contentZh: 苹果公司今天宣布开展一项新研究，旨在更好地了解人们如何与对话式人工智能健康工具互动，以及这些工具的回复实际上有多大用处。该公司正在与OpenEvidence合作开展Apple Health AI使用情况研究。OpenEvidence是一个由医疗保健专业人员使用的临床AI平台，它根据医疗 […] 生成答案。

articles.title: Listen to this: Armand Hammer’s Snakes & Ladders
articles.content: I open with this caveat: I haven't had a ton of time to digest the surprise Armand Hammer record that dropped this week. Billy Woods and Elucid rarely miss, though, and my initial reaction is that Snakes & Ladders ranks among their best. It doesn't have the seamless throughline production-wise that their collabs with Alchemist […]
articles.contentZh: 我首先要说明的是：我没有太多时间来消化本周突然发布的Armand Hammer专辑。不过，Billy Woods和Elucid很少失手，我的第一反应是，《Snakes & Ladders》堪称他们的巅峰之作。在制作方面，它不像他们与Alchemist的合作那样有贯穿始终的流畅性……
